fields.Name: Predictive Studio Maintenance
fields.Description: Disabled: no Action backs this job yet. It will run the Predictive Studio maintenance pass (staleness, scheduled re-scoring, retraining with a challenger comparison) once that action exists. WIRING NOTE: when the action lands, add Configuration.ActionID = '@lookup:MJ: Actions.DriverClass=PredictiveStudioRunMaintenancePassAction'; it is omitted today because an unresolvable @lookup fails and rolls back the entire scheduled-jobs push.

fields.Name: Predictive Studio Drift Evaluation
fields.Description: Disabled by default. When enabled by an administrator, runs the weekly Predictive Studio feature and prediction drift evaluation pass across active ML Model and Infer Record Processes (Population Stability Index, confidence-floor degradation, and champion-vs-challenger shadow divergence) via PredictiveStudioEvaluateDriftAction. To receive alert notifications, set NotifyUserID in Configuration.Params under ActionScheduledJobDriver.
